submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at a 2.0 mm gap achieves the best time resolution (0.9 ns per simulation and historical summary). It complies with all project constraints: it is an allowed candidate, compatible with the gas system and HV infrastructure, and the recirculation system ensures environmental policy compliance.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies.
requirements.evidence: All mixtures including Mixture-G3 will use closed-loop recirculation systems as per gas_recirculation.md, satisfying environmental policies.
Recommended gap is 2.0 mm, which is within the 1–3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Simulation shows Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm gap has the best time resolution (0.9 ns).
